items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: George Gershwin's sister... George Gershwin... Everybody loved his music... I think he was the favorite of George Gershwin

ctx.x: You were dancing while you were singing?

No. See, we had -- my partner sang the song. He sang and I danced. And then I sang while he danced. Like that, see? It was a separation dance, you know. Like I say, each one of them -- I think Mr. Bubbles has got that song, that music, the words to it, or this lady down at 57th Street, George Gershwin's sister. I think I can get it from her. See, once they pass, you see these people died, you see. I try to discontinue remembering some of the things that we were mostly attached to, you see. Because I was kind of…
Who else would you say you were great friends with, like at the time of the Hoofers Club, or -- was anybody else inspiring you other than John Bubbles?
